dogecoin.text: What will you tell your grandchildren of this day? That you held your #dogecoin? or paperpawed with your tail between your legs?
Even if #dogecoin doesn't moon today, remember that gains have been made with more awareness and @Newegg starting to accept it as payment. That's still a victory folks.
#dogecoin correcting from dips and gains to stay at 0.420 on 4/20 has to be the most beautiful thing I have seen the masses work together for in a long time.
